tribal_context: Ohio has no federally recognized tribes with reservations currently within state borders — tribal territories were ceded through 19th century treaties. Eight tribes have historical Ohio connections (Shawnee, Delaware, Ottawa, Wyandot, Miami, Potawatomi, Seneca-Cayuga, Seneca Nation). Enrolled members reside in Ohio as urban AI/AN residents. Route through urban Indian programs and tribal social services in Oklahoma and other home states.

tribal_entities.name: Native American Indian Center of Central Ohio (NAICCO)
tribal_entities.services: Social services, cultural programs, referral, ICWA navigation, elder support

tribal_entities.name: IHS Great Lakes Area Office
tribal_entities.services: IHS Urban Indian Health Program referrals, tribal health program connections

activation_steps: ICWA applies for child welfare regardless of residence
Route to NAICCO (Columbus) or AIEC (Cleveland) for ICWA navigation
Contact tribal enrollment office in home state for verification
